Result: B 3.5 points higher (95% CI -2.3 to 9.3; p = 0.21). Inconclusive: compatible with no benefit and with more than the 4-point target.

The clinic considers 4 points a worthwhile difference.

parts.criteria: p = 0.21 means the data are not very incompatible with no difference; it does not show no difference. The 95% CI (-2.3 to 9.3) includes the 4-point target; with power near 24% a real difference would usually be missed (Type II error).

scoring.modelReasoning: p = 0.21 from 6 people per group is not evidence that B is no better. The difference is 3.5 points with a 95% CI from -2.3 to 9.3, which includes the clinic's 4-point target, and power to detect 4 points was about 24%, so a real difference would usually be missed. Report the estimate and interval as inconclusive and the sample needed (about 26 per group). 'Not significant' alone invites the misreading; testing until p < 0.05 inflates the Type I error rate.
